01.question: Where can our projects be hosted?
01.answer: The infrastructure is fully adaptable. Projects can be deployed on cloud platforms, dedicated servers, the client's own infrastructure, or another environment required by the project.

02.question: What does your delivery include?
02.answer: Our work can cover the entire process, from the initial idea to development, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. We can also adapt the delivery model to the client's specific structure and requirements.

03.question: How does the development process work?
03.answer: The process is divided into three simple stages:

steps.01: The client completes an initial briefing with our AI agent.
steps.02: We schedule a call to align requirements, details, scope, and budget.
steps.03: We develop, deliver, and deploy the solution.

04.question: Can you integrate the project with our existing systems?
04.answer: Yes. We can integrate solutions through APIs, MCP, webhooks, databases, third-party platforms, or other formats required by the client's infrastructure.

05.question: How does communication work across different time zones?
05.answer: We are fully aligned with American time zones and friendly to European schedules. We normally recommend meetings during the European afternoon, but extended or 24-hour availability can be discussed for specific projects.

06.question: Do you provide support after delivery?
06.answer: Yes. Support requirements are defined according to each project's complexity and operational needs. Regular support can be provided through a monthly maintenance plan.

07.question: How do you ensure application security?
07.answer: Projects go through technical testing and specialized security reviews, following established market practices for architecture, access control, credentials, integrations, dependencies, and data protection.

08.question: Why hire your agency instead of a European agency?
08.answer: We combine quality, efficient delivery, integrated services, and a more accessible operational structure. This allows us to deliver high-value solutions with a favorable balance between expertise, quality, and cost, supported by the multidisciplinary experience of our founder.

09.question: Does a more competitive price mean lower quality?
09.answer: No. Quality, engineering, and security come first. Our pricing is more competitive because we use AI efficiently to optimize research, development, testing, and documentation while preserving human oversight, functionality, and professional standards.

about.heroLead: Bruno works at the intersection of product design, artificial intelligence, and business strategy. His practice combines two decades of creative experience with a systems mindset to turn complex ideas into useful, understandable, and carefully crafted digital products.
about.heroBioLead: Bruno Cesar is an AI Architect and Prompt Engineer whose career has evolved alongside digital technology itself. He began in 1997 as a Multimedia Designer, exploring interactive media in the early CD-ROM era...
heroBioMore: He went on to work across Art Direction, Motion Design, UI/UX, and Product Design, while gradually moving closer to the technology behind the experiences he created.
Over more than two decades, he has led digital projects, collaborated with multidisciplinary teams, and developed a growing understanding of software, systems, and technology.

When AI emerged as a new creative and technological frontier, he immersed himself in Prompt Engineering and AI research, later expanding into agents, RAG, context engineering, DevOps, and AI architecture.

Today, he brings this entire trajectory together in the way he approaches AI: with the curiosity of a creator, the perspective of a designer, and the mindset of someone who understands how systems are built.

01.title: Where it all began
01.text: In 1997, I was a young guy, curious and fascinated by technology and interactivity. Floppy disks held only 1.44 MB, monitors commonly displayed 256 colors, and a 100 MB Zip disk felt enormous. I began creating AutoRun multimedia experiences with Macromedia Director and experimenting with HTML 2 websites in Notepad. During that period, I learned the fundamentals of usability that remain solid foundations in my work today.

02.title: A broader creative practice
02.text: As technology and the web evolved, my work expanded into Web Design, Art Direction, and Motion Design. I created websites, microsites, interactive projects, and campaigns for brands such as TIM, Chevrolet, Coca-Cola, and Petrobras. At that time, Flash brought an impressive level of interaction to the web, while I also dedicated significant time to motion design and advanced 3D, entering a fascinating world of animation and storytelling.
stack: Macromedia Flash, After Effects, Apple Motion

03.title: From screens to products
03.text: Then smartphones changed how people interacted with technology. I moved naturally into UI/UX and Product Design, working with information architecture, digital products, and online platforms. I also created Tutorial Master, sharing design and technology content with a community that grew to more than 150,000 followers and students.

04.title: From products to systems
04.text: As I began leading multidisciplinary projects, I moved closer to the technical teams behind the products I was designing. At Ecofactor, I combined product thinking with team leadership and system architecture, expanding my work into software development, databases, APIs, and full-stack applications.

05.title: Entering the AI frontier
05.text: From the early days of ChatGPT, I immersed myself in Prompt Engineering and AI research, winning multiple international hackathons along the way. This evolved into Context Engineering, AI agents, RAG, and knowledge systems. Today, at Dante AI and CriativAI, I bring together Product Design, software, infrastructure, and AI Architecture to build reliable systems from concept to production.

research.dek1: It is all about creative thinking,
research.intro: With the goal of delving as deeply as possible and uncovering the most advanced potential and features of ChatGPT, I embarked on my own creative ChatGPT research. Utilizing a design thinking approach and armed with my creative skills and full of questions, I dove into this process of testing and interesting experimentation. I had the opportunity to discover new concepts, interesting insights, and even developed a new promising prompt engineering technique with great potential for optimizing the development process and reducing development costs. Below, I share these new concepts and techniques.

cpt.title: [CPT] Concatenated Prompt Technique
cpt.summary: A new and promising prompt engineering technique that enables ChatGPT to handle and process multiple prompts with different instructions simultaneously in a single prompt input. CPT streamlines interaction with AI by merging complex commands, enhancing efficiency, reducing API calls, and cutting development costs.

ux.title: UX Prompt Design
ux.summary: A concept that transforms ChatGPT from a simple, limited text environment into a richer and more immersive experience. Advanced Markdown with precise output instructions enables creative professionals to craft refined chat experiences.

promptApp.title: PromptApp Concept
promptApp.summary: A PromptApp is a new class of application created solely through prompts to run within the ChatGPT environment, treating ChatGPT as both the platform and interpreter for the app.

metagraph.title: Metagraph Chunk
metagraph.summary: Metagraph Chunk is a semantic enrichment method designed to make each chunk more meaningful before it reaches retrieval. During preprocessing, source content is analyzed for structural and contextual information such as hierarchy, entity relationships, related concepts, scope, and agent instructions, then embedded directly into the chunk metadata.
metagraph.detail1: The chunk therefore carries more than its original text. It also carries the context needed to understand where the information belongs and how it relates to the rest of the knowledge base, turning each chunk into a self-contained knowledge unit.
metagraph.detail2: This enriched structure gives the chunk greater semantic value during retrieval and provides the AI with more complete context when the information is returned. Instead of forcing the model to reconstruct hierarchy, relationships, and applicability from disconnected pieces at inference time, those elements are already available within the retrieved unit. The result is an implicit semantic graph around the original content, reducing contextual reconstruction and improving retrieval precision, grounding, and response accuracy.

selfContained.title: Self-Contained Knowledge Unit
selfContained.summary: A Self-Contained Knowledge Unit is a chunk enriched with the contextual information an AI system needs to correctly interpret and use it without reconstructing essential meaning from multiple disconnected retrievals. Relevant context such as hierarchy, scope, dependencies, applicability, and semantic relationships is embedded directly into the chunk metadata.
selfContained.strong: This transforms an isolated piece of information into a self-contained knowledge unit that already carries the context required for accurate interpretation.
selfContained.detail1: In Dante IA, for example, retrieving the text of a Brazilian legal provision alone was insufficient. The system also needed to understand where that provision belonged within the legal hierarchy and the context governing its application.
selfContained.detail2: By incorporating this information into each unit, an isolated legal chunk became self-contained knowledge. The principle is simple: move essential contextual reasoning from inference time to preprocessing time, reducing the model's cognitive burden while making retrieval and responses more precise, efficient, and reliable.

fullPrompt.title: Full Prompt Concept
fullPrompt.summary: A Full Prompt describes the optimal state of a prompt: complete and filled with all the information the AI needs to address a request precisely, including detailed output format instructions.

cpt.title: CPT | Concatenated Prompt Technique
cpt.introBefore: It is a new and promising prompt engineering technique that I created, enabling
cpt.introStrongOne: ChatGPT to execute multiple prompts in a single input
cpt.introMiddle: This can significantly simplify the development of any AI system by enabling the model to manage more complex interactions that behave like regular app or website functionality,
cpt.introStrongTwo: all inside one single CPT prompt
cpt.howText: This technique gives the AI one prompt containing several different prompts, each with its own job. We tell the AI to read the large prompt as a collection of individual prompts rather than one instruction. Special markers, or placeholders, show where each prompt starts and ends. Take a closer look below for a real example.
cpt.milestoneText: For this presentation, I designed the CPT Milestone, the first concatenated prompt, to demonstrate the capabilities of CPT. Imagine that we want to implement an AI system with the four main functionalities below:

milestoneItems.02: Text 2 Emoji converter prompt, called Text2Emoji.
milestoneItems.03: Unicode Icon Discovery prompt, called ICON MACHINE, a third-place FlowGPT Hackathon winner.
milestoneItems.04: Automatic Counter Answer prompt that counts all its responses to improve surveys.

cpt.regularTitle: Example of a regular AI system implementation
cpt.regularText: In a conventional scenario, when an AI system has many function requirements like these, each function is typically implemented independently. Developers then assemble all the parts in the system. This makes development more laborious, time-consuming, and costly. The more functions we want, the more code and system setup is needed behind the scenes.
cpt.potentialTitle: Example of [CPT] Concatenated Prompt Technique potential
cpt.potentialText: Because CPT can consolidate multiple prompts into a single text prompt input, all four functionalities above can run from one CPT prompt. This significantly reduces the development team's workload and makes the project simpler and more cost-effective.
cpt.functionalText: This CPT Prompt example also uses advanced content formatting, displaying precise pages with customized headers, footers, tables, hyperlinks, and images. It provides a much better user experience resembling a website or regular application built into ChatGPT.

promptApp.title: PromptApp Concept
promptApp.introBefore: In my exploration of ChatGPT's capabilities, I discovered new concepts. Things became especially interesting when I started combining them. By merging
promptApp.introMiddle: with enhanced control over ChatGPT outputs through
promptApp.introAfter: , an intriguing type of application emerged. It acts like an app but operates from a single text document, the prompt, without development environments, programming languages, compilers, or other tools. An entire application can be coded into one prompt using structured natural language and executed directly by ChatGPT, with precisely formatted content for a much better user experience. See below for more details...
promptApp.whyText: Prompt apps represent a new application concept between a traditional app and a simple prompt. They are more robust than a simple prompt, offering a wider range of out-of-the-box functionality, yet simpler and cheaper to create than traditional apps that require programming skills.
promptApp.futureTitle: PromptApps and the future of Prompt Engineering
promptApp.futureText: Prompt apps offer a simpler, faster, and more cost-effective alternative for developing AI-based solutions. As language models advance, prompts will handle more instructions, especially with the addition of CPT, enabling countless instructions to run simultaneously and instantly. Because of their simplicity and promising future, prompt apps will play a significant role in this new era of AI-driven applications. See the diagram below:
